privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we protect your data and privacy
privacy.dataCollectionDesc: We collect only the information necessary to provide our services:
dataCollectionItems: Account details from Google Sign-In (name, email address, profile photo)
Meeting details you create or import (title, date, time, participants, links)
Preferences and settings (language, alert preferences, calendar choices)
Messages you send to the AI assistant
Crash and error reports to keep the app working
privacy.dataUsageDesc: Your data is used exclusively for:
dataUsageItems: Providing meeting management and calendar sync
Sending meeting alerts, reminders and follow-ups
Answering your requests to the AI assistant
privacy.dataSharingDesc: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information. We may share data only when:
dataSharingItems: With service providers that run the app for us: Google Firebase (sign-in, database, server functions) and OpenAI (processes the messages you send to the AI assistant through our server)
With Google Calendar or your device calendar, only when you connect them
When required by law or legal process
dataSecurityItems: Encryption in transit (TLS) and at rest on Google Cloud infrastructure
Your data is only accessible to your own account
AI requests go through our server; the app never contains AI provider keys
Google Calendar access tokens stay on your device and are never stored on our servers
yourRightsItems: Delete your account and all your data from the app settings
Export your data in a portable format
Disconnect Google Calendar at any time
privacy.cookiesDesc: The mobile app does not use advertising cookies or cross-app tracking.
cookiesItems: Local storage on your device to keep you signed in and work offline
privacy.contactUsDesc: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us:
